payload.summary:
While at anchor, a crew member was confronted by six
perpetrators, reportedly armed with knives at Bay 02 on the
forward part of the ship. The crew was threatened, ordered
to remain silent and confined in the bosun store located
beneath the forward mooring station. The crew member
later freed himself and activated the fire alarm. The
perpetrators briefly returned but were unable to gain entry,
and subsequently escaped from the ship via the deck
leading overboard.
An immediate search was conducted onboard, with no
perpetrators found onboard. The crew was not injured.
Some unsecured items were stolen.
Subsequent investigation by ship crew revealed that the
padlock and securing arrangement of the bosun store door
had been tampered with, indicating forced entry. The stern
access to the engineer’s passageway was also found to
have been tampered with.
The incident was reported to local Coast Guard and
customs authorities.
